name: Draw40
original_description: Draw40 is an independent app that helps you create, find, view, and edit saved diagrams and whiteboards in your private workspace through ChatGPT. Ask to add or update shapes, text, and connections, or open a board to pan and zoom in an inline canvas. Enter fullscreen to edit directly, then explicitly save or discard your changes. You can also rename boards, move them into existing folders, delete individual boards, and open saved boards on the website. The interface supports English and Simplified Chinese. Saves can overwrite concurrent edits, and deleted boards have no restore feature.
